sequencia.ativacao: activation bar: the participant is processing
estados.transicao: the transition occurs on the event, if the guard holds, and executes the action
bpmn.kicker: BPMN 2.0 · editable in Camunda Modeler or at demo.bpmn.io
der.significado.forte: exists on its own; other tables reference it
der.significado.dependente: only exists linked to a strong entity
der.significado.associativa: links two entities, many to many
der.significado.controle: controls a process: run, batch, schedule
der.significado.fato: something that happened; recorded once, never changes
der.significado.versionada: each change is a new version; the previous one remains
der.significado.trilha: outbox (event to publish) or consumer deduplication
der.significado.dominio: closed list of values (status, type, cause)
der.significado.configuracao: rule checked by the database: allowed transitions
der.significado.referencia: official list loaded from an external source (currencies, countries)
der.significado.visao: materialized view built from other schemas
der.recusa_troca: the database rejects other status changes
der.sem_uso: no column uses it (configuration rules only)
der.faixa: Domain and configuration · {n} tables · green columns store an id from one of these, without an arrow
der.fronteira_leitura: Boundary with other schemas · logical reference: the id points to a row there, without an FK
der.fronteira_fk: Boundary with other schemas · FK without reads: the database guarantees the row exists; the service does not read the other table
der.fk_obrigatoria: Required FK: points to exactly one row
der.fk_opcional: Optional FK: points to zero or one row
der.lado_n: the N side: zero or many rows per key
der.so_view: view only: the id points to the table, without an FK
der.rotulo_coluna: Label to the right of the column
der.dominio_sem_seta: id from a domain or reference table, without an arrow
der.nome_faixa: the name did not fit: the table is in the domain band
der.fk_outro_schema: FK to a table in another schema, without an arrow
der.copia_deliberada: FK shown without an arrow: deliberate copy, reason in label
der.chaves: primary, foreign, unique key; id: id in a read view
der.tracejado: dashed outline: table from another schema
der.matriz.sub: Each cell counts columns in the row schema that point to a table in the column schema. These are FKs without reads: the database guarantees the row exists, and the service does not read the other table.
der.matriz.quantos: how many schemas point to it
der.matriz.diagonal: Dark diagonal: how many tables the schema has. The total is {n}.
der.matriz.cor: Cell color: stronger means more referencing columns. The densest pair has {n} columns.
der.matriz.dependencias: {usado} is referenced most: {nUsado} schemas depend on it. {depende} has the most dependencies: it points to {nDepende}.
